# Test HR Policy Fixture

## Paid Time Off
Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual paid time off (PTO) per year.
Up to 5 unused PTO days roll over annually.

## Parental Leave
Employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave with 30 days advance notice.

## Expenses
Domestic meal per diem is 75 USD per day with receipts above 25 USD.
Contact HR at hr-ops@example.com or 555-234-5678 for exceptions.
